title: A Cipher for the Verdict
author: Juniper Underhill
blurb: Casper Pemberton, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the trial begins.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
